blind_model.description: model family/id that authored the context-starved blind plan B

framework_model.description: model that authored the framework plan F

registry_version.description: model-registry version — anchors the v2 model-upgrade rot sentinel

floor_verdict.description: pass = F shipped, zero uncertified REMOVE/ALTER; blind-adopted = B shipped verbatim (retention escape hatch); fail = uncertified removal/weakening detected (WARN in v1, BLOCK in v2)

refined.description: changed B-elements with a valid cross-family certified_strict_improvement

removed.description: B-elements absent from F WITHOUT a valid cross-family certification (violations)

altered.description: changed B-elements WITHOUT a valid cross-family certification (violations)

reviewer_family.description: MUST differ from the orchestrator family (anthropic). check-chain-receipts re-derives this; a pass/refined row certified by reviewer_family==anthropic is a forged verdict (rejected).

contamination_note.description: honest disclosure: B was authored context-starved but by the same model family as F, so it is not provably framework-free (WI-410 accepted risk)
